description: Find due cards and apply review-state actions such as answering, suspending, unsuspending, resetting, and relearning cards. Use this for scheduling and review flow, not for editing note content or reorganizing decks. Several operations mutate card state in Anki immediately; `find_due` and `check_status` are read-only. Select `operation`, then pass either `query`, `cardIds`, or `answers` as required for that action.

days.description: Days from today for due date (for reschedule)

query.description: Search query to find cards (for find_due)

name: study_session
